sentences: You bought a one terabyte drive.
It's two different ways of counting.
To them, one terabyte is exactly one trillion bytes.
But Windows counts in powers of two.
To Windows, a gigabyte is 1,024 times 1,024 times 1,024 bytes, which is a bit more than a billion.
Divide one trillion bytes by that bigger number, and you get about 931.
Your drive is exactly the size on the box.
More PC hardware explained on the channel.
